data.summary: Results-oriented Senior Executive with over 1 year and 5 months of professional experience in field sales and back-office operations. Proven track record in B2B client acquisition, lead management, and conducting face-to-face meetings to onboard manufacturers, traders, and wholesalers. Possesses a solid academic foundation with an MBA/PGDM (2025) and comprehensive skills in data entry, Excel, Tally software, and MS Office. Seeking to leverage expertise in client relations and operational support within a dynamic and challenging business environment.
